updates.interpretation: This presentation release promotes completed reusable decisions rather than claiming new scientific convergence. CAS11 equilibrium2048 roots pass independent spectral/export/phase/identical-window gates and are the smallest tested qualified count,with7.69GiB/2.45h replay cost; this choice is conditional on the tested model and is not transferable qualification of CAS12 or all sweep geometries. Three CAS11 anchor fit candidates are discrete calibration evidence,not a continuous or qualified pole curve. Neutral QZ/5Z data pass stability,basis-relative and held-point interpolation checks only over1.9–2.5bohr; correlation-model uncertainty and stretched stability remain open. Physical A2 retained-five projections on four route links expose measured omitted-channel weight,including root7/root9 beyond root6; six/twelve-root bars are diagnostic projections,not native scattering channel controls or a global identity gate. Target/import conventions and declared budgets can be reused,while electronic basis,active-space,ensemble,explicit-channel convergence,extraction,continuity,neutral correlation and a frozen restartable production pilot remain unresolved. Both finite services are observed active at08:37:49UTC with a current heartbeat and no recorded owner error; no native exit,completed eigenpairs or affordable/truncation verdict is recorded. Original shared-memory/TZ/QC/package failures and all historical releases remain preserved.
